bio: The industrial sobriety of Wilford T contrasts with the works of art in the Wilford X exhibition gallery next-door. Meals are served in this arty establishment steeped in serenity, which provides the perfect foil to the exceptionally pure flavours. Chef Vermeiren, who doesn’t hesitate to add the finishing touch right in front of diners, is committed to highlighting the ingredient with unusual combinations. Sometimes complex, always flavoursome....
